summary: ChronoScale Corp filed an 8-K reporting the appointment of Andrew Cordell Schaap to its board of directors and related committee assignments, effective June 29, 2026. Mr. Schaap received a restricted stock award of 200,000 shares vesting over two years. The filing also discloses a data center lease between a subsidiary and a company where Mr. Schaap serves as CEO. These are routine governance and compensatory arrangements, not a special situation.
